messages:
phil: opened a small PR to tighten eviction vs preemption wording and include a compact SDK + YAML example for scale_policy. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1540

phil: main asks: (1) show queue_limit + cooldown interplay, (2) include error payload for 429 and translator context, (3) fix the broken internal anchor to the fallback behavior section.

katie: +1. users keep asking "when will eviction actually happen?" so a short timeline sentence helps.

sam: dropping a minimal YAML for the doc: 
```yaml
scale_policy:
  mode: autoscale
  cooldown_seconds: 75
  queue_limit: 200
  reserved_burst: 1
  fallback_policy: "reserved-pool-fallback"
```

sam: and a tiny SDK hint (we currently accept both names in the client):
```python
# SDK note: cooldown_sec is an accepted alias for cooldown_seconds
client.set_scale_policy(tenant_id="acct-99", policy=policy)
```

mia: adding the 429 example payload for product teams:
```json
{
  "error": "queue_full",
  "status": 429,
  "retry_after_seconds": 60
}
```

mia: i18n comment to add: // context: 429 indicates temporary queue saturation; callers should back off (exponential backoff) and may route to an alternate region.

infra-bot: linkcheck: broken anchor detected -> #fallback-behavior (line 18)

phil: thanks bot. i'll fix the anchor and update the glossary link. plan: katie to do a copyedit pass, sam to confirm the SDK alias with client team, mia to add translator strings. merge target: tomorrow AM if CI green.

docs-ci: lint: ok, linkcheck: pending, build: pending

phil: keeping this focused so teams can ship clarity for Dedicated customers. :rocket:
